localFacts.fact: ImmoScout24 tells sellers to shoot listing photos in landscape format, from a corner of the room, and to level the camera on a tripod at hip height (Hüfthöhe) – the levelling a geared head does axis by axis.
German terms: Getriebeneiger (geared head), 3-Wege-Neiger, Kugelkopf, Schnellwechselplatte, Wasserwaage/Libelle, L-Winkel; Arca-Swiss keeps its name.
Arca-Swiss's German shop describes the d4 as the combination of a 3-way head and a geared head (speed plus precision).

localPainPoints.pain: The Manfrotto 410 plate is proprietary and hard to remove one-handed; geared heads are slow for quick changes.
localPainPoints.fix: Pick the plate system first (410PL vs Arca-type) and use the geared head where precision beats speed, as in the post.

quotes.text: Leider kann nur die Manfrotto Kameraplatte genutzt werden, aber diese hält bombenfest in der Kopfaufnahme.
Die Kameraplatte ist aufgrund ihrer Arretierung, einhändig nur schwer vom Getriebeneiger zu entfernen, was mit unter zeitaufwendig sein kann.

localPainPoints.pain: German photographers ask whether the Arca-Swiss d4 is worth its price.
localPainPoints.fix: The post's answer: worth it for full-time architecture work; the Benro GD3WH covers a typical interior kit.
